title: Page 2
content_zh:
“天海……”杜天云望着弟弟胸前的项链，本想说些什么，门外却传来饭店人员的声音——
“杜先生，婚礼差不多要开始喽，请你准备。”
“知道了。”杜天云朝门的方向应了声。
“快去结婚吧，人家在催了。”杜天海把手插回口袋里，一脸帅气的要他快去娶妻。既然大哥是心甘情愿踏进这没有爱情的坟墓里，当弟弟的也不再多说什么了。
“天……”
“天什么天，啰哩叭嗦的，要我牵你的手进礼堂吗？”知道大哥想说些什么，杜天海赶紧岔开话题，揶揄他这种婆婆妈妈的态度跟准备要出嫁的女人没两样。
“胡说什么，要也是爸来牵，轮不到你。”杜天云莞尔，套上白色手套，同样也知道弟弟安的是什么心。婚礼在即，今天就先放过他一次，择日另行开导。
“去你的。”杜天海往他胸口捶了一拳，兄弟俩相视而笑，一前一后地走向会场。
随即，这场华丽的豪门婚礼正式展开。
新人在缤纷的花朵中步入会场，在众亲友的见证下许诺一个不对等的誓言，交换彼此的婚戒……
三年后——
人来人往的国际机场，关佳颖拉着行李箱走进入境大厅，摘下遮住半张脸的墨镜，立刻左右张望，灵气的双眼转呀转地，搜寻那道令她思念已久的身影……
“小姐。”一个中年男子在接机的人群中朝她挥手。
“怎么是您？”她没预料到会看见自家的司机前来接机。
司机迎向前来替她拿行李。“董事长说杜先生临时有重要的公事走不开，要我先过来接妳回家休息，他晚点再来接妳。”
“喔。”听到司机的话，关佳颖脸上露出明显的失望，因为她本来以为一下飞机就看得到朝思暮想的丈夫，还特地在下飞机前化了淡妆，这下全都白搭了。
带着无奈的心情，她顶着太阳走出机场，回到关家。
“爸，妈，我回来了。”进了客厅，她跟父母亲打招呼，声音却有些懒洋洋的。
“快过来，让我抱抱我的宝贝女儿。”谢淑云马上招手要女儿坐到身边，慈爱的搂搂宝贝女儿的肩膀。“肚子饿不饿？要不要先吃点东西？”
关佳颖摇摇头，撒娇地靠在母亲怀里。

“提早回来怎么不说一声？还要女婿告诉我才知道。”关嘉成对女儿提早归国却只记得通知丈夫，没告知父母的做法颇有微辞。
“那您现在还不是知道了，又没差……哦？”她搂住母亲，看关母就没对这点表示任何不满。
“是呀，我只要我的宝贝平安回来就好了。”谢淑云笑着摸摸女儿的头发，给予温柔的包容。女儿比预定的时间提前回国，她可高兴了。
然而关嘉成可就没那么好打发了——
“怎么会没差！这么久不见，难道妳都不想我们啊？要回来连通电话都没有，心里就只有妳丈夫。”一想到女儿回国的消息居然是透过女婿才知道，他这个当爸的人心里就不太平衡，有种很受忽略的感觉。
“爸，您忘了我们上个月才见过面而已吗？而且还拍了一大堆照片耶。”关佳颖提醒父亲别那么健忘，说得一副他们几年不见的样子，其实上个月他们夫妻俩才一起到学校去参加她的毕业典礼而已，一家三口还顺便度了几天假呢！
“更何况我现在已经嫁人了，心里惦记着我老公有什么不对。”她理所当然地说，在双亲面前毫不掩藏自己对丈夫的爱意，笑得一脸甜蜜。
虽然这样比较对父母亲不太公平，但比起每隔几个月就会去探望她一趟的爸妈，自结婚典礼后就没见过面的丈夫当然是稀罕一点喽，而且她等这天可是等了三年多了呢！
不对，如果打从他们初次见面那天算起，就是四年多了……
“听听妳说的话，一个女孩子家懂不懂得害臊啊。”关嘉成调侃女儿在父母亲面前说话也不知道含蓄一点，真没个大家闺秀的样子。
当年她也是这样吵着非要嫁给杜天云不可，说什么她对人家一见钟情，在大学毕业前就要求他这个当爸的一定要帮忙安排相亲，否则就不愿意照他的安排出国留学，再乖乖回来接手“联鑫”的管理工作，害他只好厚着这张老脸皮去托人说媒，想尽办法让她早早出嫁……
“有什么好害臊的，我爱我老公是天经地义的呀！”她觉得在家里说话没什么好拘谨的，尤其是在疼爱她的父母面前，偶尔任性加耍赖也没关系。
“不过我也要特别谢谢我亲爱的爸爸，当初若不是有您出面帮我们牵红线，女儿我又怎么会这么顺利的认识我老公，嫁给他过着幸福快乐的生活呢。”她喜眉笑眼地感谢父亲的帮忙，一直以为杜天云是因为对她很有好感，才会在短时间内向她开口求婚的，并不晓得父亲私下和她心仪的男人作过什么协议。
“妳的婚姻生活都还没开始呢，现在谈幸不幸福似乎太早了点。”关嘉成颇不是滋味地说，其实心里一直不太舍得这么早就把独生女嫁出门去当别人的老婆，总有种心肝宝贝被人抢走的感觉。
而且虽然杜天云看起来是个有担当又挺可靠的男人，也亲口答应过他婚后会好好对待他女儿，但毕竟小两口没有经过长时间相处，谁知道他们日后的婚姻生活会不会真的幸福美满。
他真怕女儿是被爱情冲昏了头，把婚姻想得太简单了。
“爸！妈～～您看爸啦！”她娇嗔地嘟起嘴，要母亲帮她讨个公道，觉得父亲这么说实在太泼她冷水了。
谢淑云立即往丈夫那儿横了一眼，用眼神责怪他哪有人这样诅咒自己女儿的婚姻的，还当着女儿的面说这些话。
关嘉成收到妻子眼里的讯息，抿了抿嘴，不太情愿地拿起桌边的报纸摊在面前，避开她们母女俩的视线，不再插嘴预言女儿的婚姻生活。
谢淑云这才又将视线转回女儿身上。“搭了那么久的飞机一定累了吧，先回房去洗个澡，休息一下。”

“好。”她乖巧地点头，觉得母亲真不愧是她永远的后盾。走了几步，她又回头问道：“妈，天云有说几点会来接我吗？”
“谁晓得，女婿可是管理一整个龙腾集团的大总裁，要忙的事情多得很，说不定要十天半个月后才有空来接妳回去。”关嘉成翻过一页报纸，又忍不住消遣起思夫心切的女儿。谁让女儿心里只有丈夫，没有爹娘。
“爸……”
“好了，妳爸跟妳开玩笑的。”谢淑云阻止他们父女俩继续抬杠，知道丈夫还不是在吃女婿的醋嘛。
“天云没说几点过来，不然妳再打个电话跟他确认一下时间吧。”
“不用了，我怕打扰他工作。”她想了下，还是要当个识大体的妻子。
“唉……怪不得人家说女大不中留，养女儿有什么用哦……”关嘉成用力抖了一下手中的报纸，叹了好长一声气。
“那您就别叫我去‘联鑫’上班啊，反正我也没什么用。”关佳颖瞅着父亲，顺水推舟地说，反正她也不太想接手公司的事，向来只对做料理和研发新菜色有兴趣而已。
“妳敢不来试试看，下星期就马上给我进公司实习。”他马上放下报纸命令道。
“这么快？！”
“妳结婚怎么不嫌快？别忘了这可是我们说好的条件。”他提醒女儿，不准她耍赖反悔，别结了婚就不认帐。
content_en:
"Tianhai..." Du Tianyun looked at the necklace on his brother's chest. He wanted to say something, but the voice of the hotel staff came from outside the door——
"Mr. Du, the wedding is about to start. Please prepare."
"I know." Du Tianyun responded in the direction of the door.
"Go get married quickly, I'm being urged." Du Tianhai put his hands back in his pockets and asked him to get married quickly with a handsome look on his face. Since the eldest brother is willing to step into this loveless grave, the younger brother doesn't say anything more.
"God..."
"What the hell, you are blabbering, do you want me to hold your hand into the auditorium?" Knowing what his elder brother wanted to say, Du Tianhai quickly changed the subject, teasing that his mother-in-law attitude was no different from that of a woman who was about to get married.
"What nonsense are you talking about? If dad is the one holding the hand, it won't be your turn." Du Tianyun smiled and put on his white gloves. He also knew what his brother was thinking about. The wedding is coming soon, so I'll let him go for now and teach him another day.
"Fuck you." Du Tianhai punched him in the chest. The two brothers smiled at each other and walked towards the venue one after another.
Immediately, this gorgeous wealthy wedding officially began.
The newlyweds entered the venue amidst colorful flowers, made an unequal vow and exchanged each other's wedding rings in the presence of relatives and friends...
Three years later——
In the international airport where people were coming and going, Guan Jiaying walked into the arrival hall with her suitcase, took off the sunglasses that covered half of her face, and immediately looked left and right, her spiritual eyes turning around, searching for that figure that she had missed for a long time...
"Miss." A middle-aged man waved to her in the crowd picking up the plane.
"Why are you?" She didn't expect to see her driver coming to pick her up.
The driver came to help her carry her luggage. "The chairman said that Mr. Du has important official business and can't leave at the moment. He asked me to come and pick you up first and take you home to rest. He will pick you up later."
"Oh." After hearing the driver's words, Guan Jiaying's face showed obvious disappointment, because she originally thought that she would see her longing husband as soon as she got off the plane, and she even put on light makeup before getting off the plane, but it was all in vain.
With a helpless mood, she walked out of the airport under the sun and returned to Guan's house.
"Dad, Mom, I'm back." After entering the living room, she greeted her parents, but her voice was a little lazy.
"Come here, let me hug my baby girl." Xie Shuyun immediately waved her daughter to sit next to her and lovingly hugged her baby girl's shoulders. "Are you hungry? Do you want to eat something first?"
Guan Jiaying shook her head and leaned into her mother's arms coquettishly.
"Why didn't you tell me that you came back early? I didn't know until my son-in-law told me." Guan Jiacheng criticized his daughter's early return but only remembered to inform her husband and not her parents.
"Then you know it now, and it's not bad...oh?" She hugged her mother and saw that Guan's mother didn't express any dissatisfaction on this point.
"Yes, I just want my baby to come back safely." Xie Shuyun smiled and touched her daughter's hair, giving her gentle tolerance. She was very happy that her daughter returned to China earlier than planned.
However, Guan Jiacheng is not so easy to deal with——
"How could it be right? We haven't seen each other for so long, don't you miss us? You won't even call me when you come back. I only have your husband in my heart." When he thought that the news of his daughter's return to China was only found out through his son-in-law, he, as a father, felt unbalanced and felt very neglected.
"Dad, have you forgotten that we just met last month? And we took a lot of photos." Guan Jiaying reminded her father not to be so forgetful, as if they hadn't seen each other for a few years. In fact, they just went to school together last month to attend her graduation ceremony, and the family of three also took a few days off!
"What's more, I'm married now, and I'm worried about what's wrong with my husband." She said matter-of-factly, not hiding it in front of her parents.Hiding her love for her husband, she smiled sweetly.
Although this comparison is unfair to her parents, compared to her parents who visit her every few months, her husband, who has not seen her since the wedding ceremony, is certainly a bit rarer. Moreover, she has been waiting for this day for more than three years!
No, if we count from the day they first met, it would be more than four years...
"Listen to what you said, a girl doesn't know how to be shy." Guan Jiacheng teased that his daughter doesn't know how to be subtle when speaking in front of her parents. She really doesn't look like a lady.
At that time, she was also clamoring to marry Du Tianyun, saying that she fell in love with him at first sight. Before graduating from college, she asked him, a father, to help arrange a blind date, otherwise she would not be willing to study abroad as he arranged, and then come back to take over the management of "Lianxin". As a result, he had no choice but to use his old face to ask matchmakers and try his best to get her married early...
"There is nothing to be ashamed of. I love my husband for granted!" She felt that there was nothing to be restrained in speaking at home, especially in front of her parents who loved her. It was okay to be willful and cheat occasionally.
"But I also want to thank my dear father. If you hadn't come forward to help us lead the way, how could my daughter have met my husband so smoothly, married him and lived a happy life." She thanked her father for his help with a smile on her face. She always thought that Du Tianyun proposed to her in a short period of time because he had a good impression of her. She didn't know what agreement her father had made with her favorite man in private.
"Your married life hasn't even started yet. It seems too early to talk about happiness or unhappiness now." Guan Jiacheng said with disgust. In fact, he had never been willing to marry off his only daughter so early to become someone else's wife. There was always a feeling that his beloved one was snatched away.
And although Du Tianyun seems to be a responsible and reliable man, and he has personally promised that he will treat his daughter well after marriage, after all, the young couple have not been together for a long time. Who knows whether their married life will be really happy in the future.
He was really afraid that his daughter would be carried away by love and think of marriage too simply.
"Dad! Mom~~Look at Dad!" She pouted coquettishly, asking her mother to help her seek justice. She felt that her father's words were too cold water on her.
Xie Shuyun immediately glanced at her husband and scolded him with her eyes, how could anyone curse his daughter's marriage like this and say these words in front of her daughter.
Guan Jiacheng received the message in his wife's eyes, pursed his lips, reluctantly picked up the newspaper on the table and spread it in front of him, avoiding the sight of the mother and daughter, and stopped interfering in predicting his daughter's marriage life.
Xie Shuyun then turned her attention back to her daughter. "You must be tired after taking such a long flight. Go back to your room to take a shower and rest."
"Okay." She nodded obediently, feeling that her mother was indeed her eternal support. After walking a few steps, she turned back and asked, "Mom, did Tianyun tell you what time you would pick me up?"
"Who knows, my son-in-law is the CEO of the entire Longteng Group. He has a lot of busy things to do. It may take ten days and a half before he is free to take you back." Guan Jiacheng turned over a page of the newspaper and couldn't help but amuse his daughter who missed her husband so much. Who makes the daughter only have her husband in her heart and not her parents.
"Dad..."
"Okay, your dad is joking with you." Xie Shuyun stopped the father and daughter from continuing to argue, knowing that her husband was still jealous of his son-in-law.
"Tianyun didn't say what time he would come, otherwise you should call him again to confirm the time."
"No, I'm afraid of disturbing his work." She thought for a moment and decided to be a sensible wife.
"Oh... no wonder people say that if a girl can't stay in college, what's the use of raising a daughter..." Guan Jiacheng shook the newspaper in his hand vigorously and sighed for a long time.A sigh of relief.
"Then don't ask me to work at Lianxin. I'm of no use anyway." Guan Jiaying looked at her father and said smoothly. She didn't really want to take over the company anyway. She was always only interested in cooking and developing new dishes.
"Don't you dare come and give me a try? You can join the company as an intern next week." He immediately put down the newspaper and ordered.
"So fast?!"
"Why don't you get married too soon? Don't forget that this is the condition we agreed upon." He reminded his daughter that she was not allowed to go back on her word and don't admit it once she got married.
